comingLast.roast: his group has him surrounded - no early mark tonight
one hot hole and the blue balls change address to Burton's locker
on 16 at 1.2 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
still swinging on 19 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
on 20, needs 2 - somebody radio ahead to the bar
2 from 4 to pass Burton - pressure golf at the wrong end of the board
finished 1 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
in on a 1-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
finished 1 above Burton - close enough to keep his speech drafted
1 above the blue line - the bar keeps updating his odds
